name: Phase 92 Text Assistant Chat and Contextual Guidance Findings Register

findings.title: Assistant ask was a unary blocking endpoint without real streaming
findings.description: POST /v1/ai/assistant/ask waited for full provider response before returning JSON, preventing real-time chunk streaming and fine-grained progressive rendering. Required Server-Sent Events (SSE) text/event-stream with frame-level chunking, Unicode boundary preservation, and disconnect cancellation.
findings.remediation: Implemented POST /v1/ai/assistant/stream with SSE protocol, emitting start, context, chunk, done, and error events with deterministic chunked transport fixtures.

findings.title: Citation deep links generated nonexistent routes and source access rejected Help IDs
findings.description: Phase 91 generated deepLink paths such as /notes?id=... and /tasks?id=..., but web routes are /library?noteId=..., /plan?targetId=...&targetType=task, and /journal?entryId=..., leading to 404s. Furthermore, AiSourceAccessRequestSchema required a UUID, failing on versioned Help citations (help:...).
findings.remediation: Repaired citation deepLink generation to use canonical routes (/library?noteId=..., /plan?targetId=..., /journal?entryId=..., /help?article=...), updated AiSourceAccessRequestSchema to accept string IDs up to 128 chars, and resolved Help article source access against HELP_ARTICLES.

findings.title: Assistant lacked strict read-only boundary enforcement
findings.description: Phase 56 allowSuggestProposal permitted heuristic proposal creation on ask. In Phase 92, the assistant must be strictly read-only question answering and contextual guidance, with no automatic tool calls, organizer writes, or execution permissions.
findings.remediation: Enforced read-only scope for Phase 92 chat: disabled autonomous proposal execution, verified that model text cannot confirm actions or bypass authorization, and maintained read-only boundaries ahead of Phase 93.

findings.title: Assistant lacked client-selected knowledge source controls
findings.description: Users could not select or filter which knowledge sources were queried (e.g. searching only Help documentation without personal notes, or omitting tasks).
findings.remediation: Added selectedSources controls to request schemas and service, allowing users to dynamically toggle Help articles, Notes, Tasks, and Journal (subject to explicit user consent).

findings.title: Assistant panel displayed empty input without contextual starter suggestions
findings.description: New users were presented with an empty textarea and no guidance on what the assistant could answer or how Daynori works.
findings.remediation: Implemented contextual starter suggestion pills for Help, notes, tasks, routines, and offline sync that populate the composer or initiate queries with one click.

findings.title: Conversation history lacked deletion and clearing controls
findings.description: Users could view prior turns but had no way to delete individual turns or clear their workspace assistant conversation history, risking accumulation of stale queries.
findings.remediation: Implemented DELETE /v1/ai/assistant/history with single-turn and workspace-wide bulk clearing, with UI controls for delete and history restart.

findings.title: Model output lacked sanitization against HTML injection and tracking images
findings.description: Raw markdown rendering could execute embedded HTML, load external tracking pixels leaking user query context, or execute javascript: URL links.
findings.remediation: Implemented sanitizeAssistantMarkdown stripping executable tags, unsafe URL schemes, and remote image loading while preserving bounded Markdown and code formatting.

findings.title: Desktop Assistant lacked persistent side panel preserving page/editor context
findings.description: AssistantPanel was an inline component on developer page rather than an accessible persistent side drawer preserving the active document/editor, and mobile lacked keyboard-safe composer handling.
findings.remediation: Rebuilt AssistantPanel as a persistent desktop side drawer with keyboard-safe composer, reachable controls, and accessible ARIA attributes, preserving the active page/editor.
